rows: 2026-11-24 — CLI performance tracing. The integration runner now accepts `wf test run --performance`, and `wf --performance <command>` records ordinary commands. Four Orca/T3 workloads repeated 30 times produced 1,921 spans across 65 operations in the final macOS arm64 debug run. The Orca artifact-open p95 was 99.79 ms and T3 project-open was 138.60 ms. Thirteen of fourteen gates passed. Executor artifact stat reached 16.09 ms against a 3.76 ms limit. Keep the failure in history and the gate enabled.
